---
title: "About"
---

This website was created on December 9, 2025 to host stuff about my Master's thesis on and (hopefully) post-Master's exploration of YM lattice gauge theory, or more generally, the Yang Mills Millenium problem.

From June 2026 - September 2026, I was writing 
my Master's thesis in a standalone document, therefore
I did not update this website.

## Stuff that I made during my research
